target_scope: Forecast future scholarly uptake, cross-field diffusion, and secondary knowledge-graph propagation at D3/D5/D8. These are observable influence signals, not total societal impact, scientific quality, innovation truth, or Nature acceptance probability.

category_inclusion_rules.K1: The category represents a distinct decision-relevant outcome, confounder/control block, or publication-time opportunity mechanism.
category_inclusion_rules.K2: At least one verifiable methodological or empirical source supports the category interpretation.
category_inclusion_rules.K3: The category boundary is explicitly separated from publication-time innovation evidence and from other prediction categories.
category_inclusion_rules.K4: The category has a frozen observation time, graph layer, and role in the two-part prediction design.
category_inclusion_rules.K5: It is computable from already frozen local ASPR assets without network access.
category_inclusion_rules.K6: It has an explicit validation, calibration, sensitivity, or baseline-comparison plan.
category_inclusion_rules.K7: Its scientific claim is narrower than the available observable data and states material interpretation limits.

variable_inclusion_rules.V1: Maps to exactly one retained prediction category and one frozen model or reporting role.
variable_inclusion_rules.V2: Has a verifiable source for the construct or method; project-defined choices are labeled as such.
variable_inclusion_rules.V3: Formula, direction-free model treatment, horizon, graph layer, and parameters are frozen.
variable_inclusion_rules.V4: Publication-time predictors obey source_max_year < publication_year; only registered outcomes may use the future window.
variable_inclusion_rules.V5: Observed zero, structural undefined, failed retrieval, and missing metadata have distinct rules.
variable_inclusion_rules.V6: Can be derived from the frozen local target, reference-closure, future-citer, or graph assets.
variable_inclusion_rules.V7: All learned transforms, encodings, imputation, calibration, and target normalization are fitted inside training folds.
variable_inclusion_rules.V8: Has a deterministic implementation and a toy or reconciliation test before sealed evaluation.
variable_inclusion_rules.V9: Is nonredundant within its registered model role; transformed duplicates are sensitivity-only.
variable_inclusion_rules.V10: Was registered before D3/D5/D8 outcome inspection or sealed-holdout evaluation.

evaluation_rules.E1: Report a proper probabilistic score for future uptake in addition to discrimination.
evaluation_rules.E2: Report nested OOF rank association for the conditional diffusion outcome with cluster-bootstrap confidence intervals.
evaluation_rules.E3: Assess calibration by reliability diagnostics and calibration intercept/slope using held-out predictions only.
evaluation_rules.E4: Report prediction-interval coverage and sharpness together; neither is sufficient alone.
evaluation_rules.E5: Evaluate ordered temporal extrapolation with a single locked sealed period and one unlock.
evaluation_rules.E6: Report 12-domain macro performance and domain sample sizes; outcome-dependent domain deletion is forbidden.
evaluation_rules.E7: Require preregistered innovation blocks to improve over the strong controls-only baseline and report opportunity-only comparisons.

category_exclusion_rules: Citation outcomes are not innovation labels, quality labels, societal-impact labels, or acceptance labels.
Future variables cannot enter publication-time innovation profiles or predictor construction.
Author prestige, institution prestige, and post-publication attention are excluded from the primary predictor set to avoid encoding status advantage.
A category is excluded if it only renames a data modality or duplicates another retained category.
A category unavailable in frozen local assets may be retained only as conditional secondary analysis, never silently imputed.
variable_exclusion_rules: Failed future-citer retrieval is missing, never zero.
Observed zero future citers is retained in the uptake denominator and never removed for model convenience.
Unbounded cumulative citations and mixed citation ages are excluded in favor of fixed D3/D5/D8 windows.
Any predictor using same-year or future graph information is excluded.
Venue, year, field size, reference-list size, and prior popularity are controls, not innovation indicators.
Author- or institution-identity features, altmetrics, and externally refreshed data are excluded from the primary local-frozen design.
Variables cannot be added, removed, thresholded, or redefined because they improve OOF or sealed results.

O1_FUTURE_UPTAKE.label: Future scholarly uptake
O1_FUTURE_UPTAKE.construct: Whether and how often the focal paper is used by later scholarly work inside a fixed post-publication window.
O1_FUTURE_UPTAKE.rationale: A zero-versus-positive process and positive magnitude are separated because observed non-use and extent of use are different events.
O1_FUTURE_UPTAKE.boundary: Citations are treated as noisy traces of scholarly uptake, not proof of quality, novelty, societal impact, or causal influence.

O2_KNOWLEDGE_DIFFUSION.label: Cross-field knowledge diffusion
O2_KNOWLEDGE_DIFFUSION.construct: The breadth and categorical diversity of future papers that cite the focal paper within D3, D5, or D8.
O2_KNOWLEDGE_DIFFUSION.rationale: Reach and Simpson diversity distinguish how widely uptake spreads from how evenly it is distributed across citing fields or topics.
O2_KNOWLEDGE_DIFFUSION.boundary: The exact multi-level rank composite and equal block weights are a frozen project estimand; the sources support its components, not those exact weights.

O3_STRUCTURAL_PROPAGATION.label: Realized structural propagation
O3_STRUCTURAL_PROPAGATION.construct: Changes in future knowledge-graph modularity, boundary mixing, partition membership, and path structure associated with later reuse of a focal paper.
O3_STRUCTURAL_PROPAGATION.rationale: Graph change provides a structurally different secondary outcome from citation incidence or categorical diffusion.
O3_STRUCTURAL_PROPAGATION.boundary: Secondary validation subset only; graph changes are associations and must not be described as causal effects of the focal paper.

K1_CITATION_OPPORTUNITY_CONTROLS.label: Citation opportunity and exposure controls
K1_CITATION_OPPORTUNITY_CONTROLS.construct: Pre-existing field, era, publication, reference-list, and prior-popularity conditions that alter the opportunity to be cited.
K1_CITATION_OPPORTUNITY_CONTROLS.rationale: A strong baseline is necessary to test whether innovation evidence adds information beyond known exposure and citation-opportunity differences.
K1_CITATION_OPPORTUNITY_CONTROLS.boundary: Controls are adjustment variables only and can never be displayed as innovation evidence.

P1_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_OPPORTUNITY.label: Bibliographic-coupling opportunity structure
P1_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_OPPORTUNITY.construct: The focal paper's publication-time position, reach, embeddedness, and accessible research-community size in a strictly prior shared-reference network.
P1_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_OPPORTUNITY.rationale: Network position can predict visibility and available audiences independently of the paper's innovation evidence.
P1_BIBLIOGRAPHIC_OPPORTUNITY.boundary: Prediction-only opportunity variables; they are reported separately and never relabelled as novelty or structural innovation.

O1.UPTAKE.formula: 1[n_future_citers > 0] for an audited complete D3/D5/D8 request
O1.UPTAKE.horizon_rule: Citations from publication_year+1 through publication_year+horizon inclusive; horizon in {3,5,8}.
O1.UPTAKE.cutoff_rule: No publication-year citations; fixed complete window per horizon.
O1.UPTAKE.zero_rule: A successful uncapped request with zero future citers is observed zero and remains in the cohort.
O1.UPTAKE.missingness_rule: Failed, absent, or window-capped retrieval is missing, never zero.
O1.UPTAKE.fold_rule: No learned transform; class weighting and calibration are training-fold only.
O1.UPTAKE.disposition_reason: Primary first-stage outcome in the preregistered two-part model.

O1.LOG_COUNT.horizon_rule: Same fixed D3/D5/D8 future window as O1.UPTAKE.
O1.LOG_COUNT.cutoff_rule: No cumulative citations outside the registered horizon.
O1.LOG_COUNT.missingness_rule: Failed or capped retrieval remains null.
O1.LOG_COUNT.fold_rule: Used descriptively and in sensitivity models; any scaling is training-fold only.
O1.LOG_COUNT.disposition_reason: Descriptive and sensitivity outcome; not the innovation label or primary conditional diffusion estimand.

O2.DIFFUSION.horizon_rule: Calculated separately at D3, D5, and D8 from future citers inside the complete fixed window.
O2.DIFFUSION.cutoff_rule: Ranks are fitted inside each training fold for modeling; a full-cohort rank is descriptive only.
O2.DIFFUSION.zero_rule: The conditional diffusion model is fitted only where future_uptake=1; observed zeros remain in the first-stage denominator.
O2.DIFFUSION.missingness_rule: Any failed retrieval or taxonomy coverage below 0.80 is null for the conditional outcome.
O2.DIFFUSION.fold_rule: Component rank references, target transforms, tuning, and calibration are training-fold only.

quality_rules.provenance: Frozen per-paper v6 target rule; sensitivity at 0.9.

O2.DIFFUSION.disposition_reason: Primary positive-uptake diffusion estimand; exact equal weights are transparently project-defined.

O2.FIELD_REACH.formula: number of distinct primary fields among valid future citers
O2.FIELD_REACH.cutoff_rule: Only valid future citers in the registered horizon.
O2.FIELD_REACH.zero_rule: Observed zero uptake has reach zero.
O2.FIELD_REACH.missingness_rule: Failed retrieval or absent taxonomy for positive citers is null.
O2.FIELD_REACH.fold_rule: Log transform and ranking are training-fold only when used in a model target.
O2.FIELD_REACH.disposition_reason: Visible component of the primary diffusion estimand.

O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.formula: 1-sum_k p_k^2 over valid future-citer primary topics
O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.cutoff_rule: Only valid future citers in the registered horizon.
O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.zero_rule: Observed zero uptake has Simpson diversity zero.
O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.missingness_rule: Failed retrieval or inadequate positive-citer taxonomy is null.
O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.fold_rule: Ranking is training-fold only when used in a model target.
O2.TOPIC_SIMPSON.disposition_reason: Visible evenness component; algebraic variants are not added as independent targets.

O3.RGPM_S.horizon_rule: D3/D5/D8 on the preregistered structural subset only.
O3.RGPM_S.cutoff_rule: Baseline graph is strictly prior; only registered future-citer links inside the horizon augment it.
O3.RGPM_S.zero_rule: No future citers is a structural no-change case only when the retrieval is successful.
O3.RGPM_S.missingness_rule: Failed retrieval, capped windows, or insufficient future-citer reference coverage is null.
O3.RGPM_S.fold_rule: Component ranks are training-fold only for predictive sensitivity; full-subset ranks are descriptive.
O3.RGPM_S.disposition_reason: Conditional secondary outcome because the exact graph composite is project-defined and available only on a prelocked subset.

K1.PUBLICATION_YEAR.formula: calendar publication year, modeled categorically or with a fold-local spline
K1.PUBLICATION_YEAR.missingness_rule: Missing publication year excludes the row before outcome inspection.
K1.PUBLICATION_YEAR.fold_rule: Encoding or spline knots are fitted on training folds only.
K1.PUBLICATION_YEAR.disposition_reason: Mandatory exposure control; never an innovation indicator.

K1.DOMAIN12.formula: frozen one-of-12 Nature natural-science domain label
K1.DOMAIN12.missingness_rule: Unmapped is an explicit category and is excluded from 12-domain macro only by the preregistered taxonomy rule, never by outcome.
K1.DOMAIN12.fold_rule: Categorical encoding is fitted on training folds; unseen labels map to an explicit unknown level.
K1.DOMAIN12.disposition_reason: Mandatory field-opportunity control and reporting stratum.

K1.VENUE.cutoff_rule: No future venue metrics or journal-impact factors.
K1.VENUE.missingness_rule: Missing venue maps to an explicit unknown level.
K1.VENUE.disposition_reason: Exposure control without externally refreshed prestige metrics.

K1.LOG_REFERENCES.cutoff_rule: Count declared focal references; feature graph uses only references dated before publication.
K1.LOG_REFERENCES.zero_rule: A truly empty declared list maps to zero and is quality-flagged.
K1.LOG_REFERENCES.missingness_rule: Unretrieved reference lists are missing, not empty.
K1.LOG_REFERENCES.fold_rule: Any centering or scaling is training-fold only.
K1.LOG_REFERENCES.disposition_reason: Strong baseline control for both citation opportunity and pair-count mechanics.

K1.REFERENCE_AGE.cutoff_rule: Every included reference year is less than focal publication year.
K1.REFERENCE_AGE.zero_rule: Same-year and future-dated references are excluded, not assigned age zero.
K1.REFERENCE_AGE.missingness_rule: No valid reference years yields null plus a missing indicator.
K1.REFERENCE_AGE.fold_rule: Imputation and scaling are training-fold only.
K1.REFERENCE_AGE.disposition_reason: Controls for recency of the cited knowledge base.

K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.formula: median strictly-prior co-citation degree of valid cited references
K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.cutoff_rule: source_max_year < publication_year for every focal row.
K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.zero_rule: A mapped isolate has degree zero.
K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.missingness_rule: No mapped cited references yields null plus a missing indicator.
K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.fold_rule: Imputation and scaling are training-fold only.
K1.PRIOR_POPULARITY.disposition_reason: Conditional sensitivity control until the full strictly-prior reference-graph degree view is materialized and coverage-audited.

P1.BC_DEGREE.formula: number of strictly-prior papers sharing at least one reference with focal / max(1,valid_reference_count)
P1.BC_DEGREE.information_time: strictly prior paper-reference incidence plus focal references
P1.BC_DEGREE.cutoff_rule: Every neighbor paper has publication_year < focal publication_year.
P1.BC_DEGREE.zero_rule: A valid paper with no prior shared-reference neighbor is zero.
P1.BC_DEGREE.missingness_rule: Fewer than two valid references or unavailable snapshot is null.
P1.BC_DEGREE.fold_rule: Any scaling or nonlinear transform is training-fold only.
P1.BC_DEGREE.disposition_reason: Primary reach measure in the separately reported opportunity block.

P1.BC_STRENGTH.formula: sum over strictly-prior neighbor papers of the number of references shared with the focal paper
P1.BC_STRENGTH.information_time: strictly prior paper-reference incidence plus focal references
P1.BC_STRENGTH.cutoff_rule: Every neighbor paper predates the focal paper.
P1.BC_STRENGTH.zero_rule: A valid paper with no prior shared reference is zero.
P1.BC_STRENGTH.missingness_rule: Unavailable or inadequate reference metadata is null.
P1.BC_STRENGTH.fold_rule: Log transform and scaling are training-fold only.
P1.BC_STRENGTH.disposition_reason: Weighted opportunity measure; kept separate from unweighted reach.

P1.BC_COMPONENT.formula: size of the focal node's augmented bibliographic-coupling component / number of eligible strictly-prior papers
P1.BC_COMPONENT.cutoff_rule: The focal node is attached using only its publication-time references.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind minimum for interpretable network position.

P1.BC_COMPONENT.disposition_reason: Available research-community size, not an innovation construct.

P1.BC_CLUSTERING.formula: number of observed edges among focal bibliographic-coupling neighbors / number of possible neighbor pairs
P1.BC_CLUSTERING.cutoff_rule: Neighbor-neighbor edges are derived only from papers predating the focal paper.
P1.BC_CLUSTERING.zero_rule: Degree below two has clustering zero with an explicit low-degree flag.
P1.BC_CLUSTERING.fold_rule: No learned transform outside training folds.
P1.BC_CLUSTERING.disposition_reason: Conditional sensitivity measure because exact neighbor-induced edges are expensive on the full graph and no approximation is admitted without equivalence evidence.

P1.BC_CLOSENESS.formula: sum over reachable prior nodes of reciprocal unweighted shortest-path distance / number of eligible prior nodes
P1.BC_CLOSENESS.cutoff_rule: The focal node is attached only through publication-time shared references.
P1.BC_CLOSENESS.zero_rule: An isolate has harmonic closeness zero.

quality_rules.provenance: Outcome-blind minimum for interpretable network position.

P1.BC_CLOSENESS.disposition_reason: Conditional sensitivity only because exact per-paper traversal may be computationally prohibitive on the full frozen graph; no approximation is admitted without a separate equivalence test.
